context: Tests whether the agent implements the JavaCV camera probe pattern from the camera-setup-javacv skill: probing multiple indices, using a brightness threshold of 10.0, waiting 500 ms after start(), supporting CAM env var override, safe cleanup, correct resolution setting, and AutoCloseable implementation.

checklist.name: Probe range 0-5
checklist.description: The probe loop iterates camera indices from 0 through at least 5 (e.g. 0..5 or a MAX_PROBE_INDEX constant equal to 5), not just index 0 alone

checklist.name: 500 ms warm-up
checklist.description: Code calls Thread.sleep(500) or equivalent (constant named WARM_UP_MS set to 500) after grabber.start() and before the first grab() call

checklist.name: Brightness threshold 10.0
checklist.description: Code uses a brightness threshold of exactly 10.0 (or a constant MIN_BRIGHTNESS = 10.0) to filter cameras whose mean brightness is below that value

checklist.name: opencv_core.mean for brightness
checklist.description: Brightness is computed using mean() from opencv_core (e.g. org.bytedeco.opencv.global.opencv_core.mean) called on the Mat, then .get(0L)

checklist.name: Safe grabber.stop()
checklist.description: grabber.stop() is called inside a runCatching { } block (or equivalent try-catch that swallows exceptions) so cleanup never throws

checklist.name: CAM env var override
checklist.description: Code reads the CAM environment variable (System.getenv("CAM")) and, when it contains a valid integer, uses that index directly instead of running the probe

checklist.name: imageWidth/imageHeight set before start
checklist.description: grabber.imageWidth and grabber.imageHeight are explicitly set before grabber.start() is called (not left at default 0)

checklist.name: AutoCloseable Camera
checklist.description: The Camera class (or equivalent wrapper) implements AutoCloseable (or Closeable), with a close() method that stops the grabber

checklist.name: Probe result data structure
checklist.description: A data class or equivalent structure holds the probe result for each camera, including at minimum: index, resolution (width/height), and brightness value

checklist.name: No hardcoded index 0
checklist.description: The camera used for capture is NOT selected as OpenCVFrameGrabber(0) unconditionally — the selected index comes from the probe or the CAM env var
